url.length.note: Each URL is at most 2,048 characters.

sitemap.first_read.note: Yandex downloads a newly added sitemap file within two weeks.

sitemap.reread.note: After a change you can ask Yandex to read a file again, up to 10 times for each site address. After that, try again 30 days after the first try.

sitemap.standard_elements.note: A plain sitemap with only standard elements. Listed on the design board, not separately confirmed.

sitemap.same_domain.note: URLs on the same domain as the site. Listed on the design board, not separately confirmed.

sitemap.reachable.note: The sitemap answers 200 and robots.txt does not block it. Listed on the design board, not separately confirmed.

sitemap.not_feed.note: A sitemap file, never an RSS or Atom feed. Listed on the design board, not separately confirmed.

verify.methods.note: A file named yandex_<code>.html in the site root with a UTF-8 content type and the text Verification: <code>, a yandex-verification meta tag, or a DNS TXT record.
